title: Sony India promoting the FX series with AI generated image full of errors
key_facts: SonyAlphaRumors says Sony India posted an image on Instagram promoting its FX series.
The site says the image is clearly AI-generated and contains many bizarre details, a few of which it highlighted.
It adds that companies increasingly use AI tools for promotional images to save money, with embarrassing results at times.
quote_evidence: on closer inspection, it's clearly AI-generated—and contains a ton of bizarre details!
Companies increasingly rely on AI tools to create promotional images.
why_it_matters_hint: A well-known brand's regional account appears to have published an error-filled AI image, a reminder of the risks of unchecked AI ads.
notes: Very short post; Sony has not commented in the text. The image's flaws are SonyAlphaRumors' own judgment; the FX series is Sony's cinema camera line (general knowledge, not in the article).
